question: Urdu is also referred to as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lashkari Zaban**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Lashkari Zaban** is another name for the Urdu language, which is widely spoken in Pakistan and India.
 
• Urdu developed during the Mughal era and is heavily influenced by Persian, Arabic, and Turkish languages.
 
• The term **"Lashkari"** means "military" or "army" in Persian, reflecting the language's origin among the soldiers of the Mughal army.
 
• **Urdu** is written in the Perso-Arabic script and has a rich literary tradition, including poetry, prose, and religious texts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shauraseni**

 
 
• Shauraseni is an ancient Middle Indo-Aryan language that is considered the predecessor of many modern Indic languages, including Hindi and Punjabi.
 
 
 
• **Farsi**
 
 
• Farsi, also known as Persian, is the official language of Iran and is also spoken in Afghanistan and Tajikistan.
 
• It belongs to the Indo-Iranian branch of the Indo-European languages.
 
 
 
• **Awadhi**
 
 
• Awadhi is an Eastern Hindi language spoken primarily in the Awadh region of India, including parts of Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh.
 
• It has a significant literary tradition, including contributions to Indian epic poetry and folklore.
 
 
 
• **Urdu**
 
 
• Urdu is a member of the Indo-Aryan language family and is closely related to Hindi.
 
• It is the national language and lingua franca of Pakistan and one of the 22 scheduled languages of India.
 
• Urdu has a rich tradition in poetry and literature, with famous poets like Mirza Ghalib and Allama Iqbal.
